subject: general
question: How many sessions of the Lok Sabha take place in a year?
solution:
The correct answer is** '3'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **T******hree****** sessions** of Lok Sabha are held in a year: **Budget session**: February to May.** Monsoon session**: July to September. **Winter session**: November to mid-December.
 
• The joint sitting of the Parliament is called by the President of India (Article 108) and is presided over by the Speaker of the **Lok Sabha** or, in their absence, by the Deputy Speaker of the Lok Sabha, or in their absence, the Deputy Chairman of the **Rajya Sabha.**
 
• India does not have a fixed parliamentary calendar. **By convention (****i.e.,**** not provided by the Constitution), Parliament meets for three sessions in a year**.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The House can have a **maximum of 552 members**, with 530 representing the States, 20 the Union Territories, and two chosen by the President from from the Anglo-Indian Community.​
 
• The **lower house **of India's bicameral Parliament is known as the **lok sabha**, officially known as the House of the People. The upper house is known as the Rajya Sabha.
 
• The **ex-officio chairman **of Rajya Sabha is the **vice president** of India.
 
• One of the two chambers of a **bicameral legislature** is the lower house, with the upper house serving as the other chamber.
 
• In many legislatures around the world, the lower house has grown to hold more power or otherwise exercise significant political influence despite its official status** "below"** the upper house.
